title: Vulnerable Component: com.acme.libs:acme-xml 1.4.2
description: acme-xml 1.4.2 resolves external entities when it parses XML documents. An attacker who controls an uploaded statement file can read files from the server (XXE).
suggestedFix: Upgrade com.acme.libs:acme-xml to version 2.0.0 or later.
